## Notes

**Quick read:** Sweet, conscientious mom of a blonde 1 year old "walking girly" who films pretty lifestyle outings (park with her doodle, a new bakery, a small-town main street) and already speaks the approved "save my arms" angle; $0 so far because only one of her two approved videos has run, on $8 of spend.
**Best next move:** close the open promise from Sep 19 (Fatima forwarded her "when will my 10% videos run?" question to media buying) with a real answer, ideally that ae8bf70b is live, because she is holding back new videos until she sees them posted.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: mom with long light-brown hair, green matching set or denim overalls, barefoot or sandals. Daughter about 12 to 14 months, blonde, just walking ("She's also a walking girly now"). Husband appears holding her hand in the bakery video; a cream goldendoodle in the park video. Settings: a leafy park lawn, a bakery counter, a brick main street with flower baskets. Blue sling plus the Attachable Pocket.
- Format: calm voiceover over lifestyle B-roll, 21 to 27 seconds, no burned-in text in the frames I saw. Hooks: "My baby may be getting bigger, but that does not mean she's becoming less of a mama's girl", "This morning we went to a new bakery that we wanted to try and let me just tell you I am so glad that I brought my Bambora toddler sling". Angles: saves my arms ("I've been looking for a solution to save my arms", "your arms aren't hurting"), easy to switch between parents (not a ton of buckles), in and out for a new walker, the phone sleeve for phone, chapstick and snacks.
- What worked: both approved. 9d235fd1 (bakery) ran in 1 ad with $8 spend; ae8bf70b (park) approved Aug 26 but has 0 ads. No sales yet, purely because of spend.
- Sheet: the 9d235fd1 sheet only captured 4 frames, so part of that video was not checked.
- Safety and checklist: one hand on her daughter in the bakery and street shots, seat under the bottom, legs out on the hip. One issue in ae8bf70b: at about 11s she uses both hands to put her phone into the pocket while her daughter is in the sling; the pocket demo needs one hand on baby or a separate shot with the sling off.
- Strengths: exactly the approved angle (arm relief) in her own words, soft aesthetic that feels premium, dad cameo, very coachable.
- To improve: film the pocket demo one-handed; more volume once she trusts the ads are running.
